upstreamBoolean.description: A YAML boolean or its quoted form. The workload chart quotes every value before it reaches the container, so both render identically.

signalcli.description: Values passed to the workload subchart. The subchart's own schema validates everything not constrained here.

replicaCount.description: signal-cli registers one device against one account and keeps state on one volume, so the wrapper cannot be scaled out.

envVars.description: Upstream environment variables. Kept open so a variable added by a newer image release can be set without waiting for a chart release; every variable the image documents is validated.

MODE.description: signal-cli execution model. json-rpc and json-rpc-native make /v1/receive/{number} a WebSocket; the others leave it a GET.

AUTO_RECEIVE_SCHEDULE.description: Cron expression calling the receive endpoint, for normal and native mode only. Do not set it while a consumer reads messages through the API: receive drains the queue from the Signal server, so whichever caller arrives second gets nothing.

DEFAULT_SIGNAL_TEXT_MODE.description: Text mode used when a send payload omits text_mode.

PORT.description: Port the API listens on. Changing it alone breaks the service and both probes, which address 8080 directly; change service.containerPort and the probe ports to match.

SIGNAL_CLI_CONFIG_DIR.description: Account state directory inside the container. Changing it alone silently discards the registration, because the volume is still mounted at the old path; change volumeMounts to match.

SIGNAL_CLI_CHOWN_ON_STARTUP.description: Set false to skip the startup chown, which is slow on a volume holding many attachments or sticker packs.

JSON_RPC_IGNORE_STICKERS.description: Set true to stop sticker packs being downloaded. Sticker packs are the largest single consumer of volume space in a long-lived account.

JSON_RPC_TRUST_NEW_IDENTITIES.description: How an unseen identity key is trusted in json-rpc mode.
